_comment: Batch 007 -- the kit that moves you.
Two of these shots carry lab_dummy (1.78 m, near the player's 1.80)
purely as a SCALE REFERENCE. A traversal module photographed alone is
a shape; photographed next to something the height of a person it is a

shots.name: T_corridor_run
shots.caption: SIX MODULES: THREE STRAIGHTS, A LEFT TURN, TWO MORE
shots.note: THE SEAMS ARE THE 4.0 M MODULE GRID. NOTHING IS STRETCHED

shots.name: T_corridor_eye
shots.caption: STANDING IN IT, AT THE ENGINE'S OWN LENS
shots.note: SERVICES TRAY AT 2.55 M - THE SAME HEIGHT ARCH_PIPE_RUN USES

shots.name: T_climb_scale
shots.caption: STAIR 2.00 M AGAINST RAMP 1.333 M - THE DUMMY IS 1.78 M
shots.note: TWICE MAX_VERTICAL_STEP, AND EXACTLY JUMP_APEX. NEITHER IS A LOOK

shots.name: T_ledge
shots.caption: LEDGE - 2.5 M DEEP, MIN_PLATFORM_SIZE, AT 3.0 M
shots.note: ANCHORED AT THE SURFACE YOU STAND ON, NOT THE BOTTOM OF ITS BRACKETS

shots.name: T_stair
shots.caption: STAIR - EIGHT 0.25 M RISERS, 2.6 M WIDE FOR THE BRUTE LANE

shots.name: T_ramp
shots.caption: RAMP - KERBS MODELLED, TREAD PATTERN PAINTED
shots.note: A KERB IS A SILHOUETTE THAT SAYS DROP. A TREAD PATTERN IS NOT

shots.name: T_corner_turn
shots.caption: INSIDE THE TURN - BOTH BORES, AT THE ENGINE'S LENS
shots.note: THE CHAMFER IS WHY THE BRUTE LANE HAS NO 90 DEGREE PINCH IN IT

shots.name: T_corner_left
shots.caption: CORNER, OUTSIDE - 4.8 M SQUARE, OPEN ON TWO FACES
shots.note: A MIRROR OF ARCH_CORNER_RIGHT, NOT ONE PIECE ROTATED
